description: A man with long curly dark hair and a full beard sits on a wooden floor playing an acoustic guitar. He is looking down at his hands with focused expression while a small effects pedal sits on the floor beside him.
title: Bearded Man Playing Guitar
prompt: A man with shoulder-length curly brown hair and a thick dark beard, wearing a grey sweatshirt and blue jeans, sits cross-legged on a light wooden floor in a bright room with slanted white walls. He is playing a well-worn natural wood acoustic guitar with tortoiseshell pickguard, left hand on the fretboard, right hand strumming. Sunlight streams from a window in the upper left, creating strong backlighting and soft highlights on his hair and the guitar. A small black guitar effects pedal with knobs and switches rests on the floor to his right. Natural, intimate, documentary-style photograph with warm tones and realistic detail.
